changeReason: The pre-E2E direct run exposed stale correction nodes after one-hop replacement when preferences were revised repeatedly. V3.1 follows correction edges transitively with predeclared hop and expansion caps. Existing arms, metrics, thresholds, and uncertainty settings are unchanged.
